svg.title: Airline Booking System - microservices
svg.desc: An airline booking backend split into five services, each owning its models and migrations. Email is asynchronous via RabbitMQ, so a booking never waits on it. RabbitMQ, MySQL, Sequelize, API gateway, JWT. Public source.
svg.text: An airline booking backend split into five services, so a slow
email server never slows down a booking.
RABBITMQ · MYSQL · SEQUELIZE · API GATEWAY · JWT
